programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: Resonance of the Soul - Will Soul Eater Become a Death Scythe?
programme.desc: With 99 evil souls consumed, Soul just needs to defeat a witch to become a Death Scythe. He and Maka make their move against Blair - but a pointy hat doesn’t always mean witch!

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: I Am the Star! The Big Man is Showing Up Here?
programme.desc: A mobster and his goons are gunning for a witch, and Black☆Star and Tsubaki want the souls of all involved. Their plan runs into trouble when the witch’s bodyguard draws his sword.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: The Perfect Boy - Death the Kid's Magnificent Mission?
programme.desc: Death the Kid, Patty, and Liz travel to the desert to battle a witch who’s raising the dead. If a horde of mummies doesn’t stop them, Kid’s freaky symmetry obsession might.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: Black-blooded Terror - There's a Weapon Inside Crona?
programme.desc: Maka and Soul’s trip to Italy turns ugly when they run into Crona and Ragnarok, a Meister and Weapon team that shares a highly unusual bond.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: Legend of the Holy Sword - Kid and Black☆Star's Great Adventure?
programme.desc: Black☆Star and Death the Kid discover the worst part of searching for the legendary Excalibur: finding the legendary Excalibur.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: The Enchanted Sword Masamune - Break the Soul Possession: A Heart Sings in the Rain?
programme.desc: Black☆Star and Tsubaki face Masamune, and as the battle against the dark Weapon escalates, it becomes clear that Tsubaki must finish the fight alone.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: Tsubaki the Camellia Blossom - What Lies Beyond the Grief?
programme.desc: Black☆Star and Tsubaki will claim their first soul if they defeat Masamune - but if Tsubaki falls, she will be absorbed forever by her powerful and bitter brother.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: The Soul Eating Black Dragon - Scaredy-cat Liz and Her Merry Friends?
programme.desc: Death the Kid and the Thompson sisters board a ghost ship full of human souls. After facing the vessel’s demented captain, true evil unfurls its wings.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: Fierce Battle Aboard the Ghost Ship - The Hell Inside My Head?
programme.desc: Unsettled by something he heard on the ghost ship, Kid asks his father an unimaginable question. Dr. Stein has his own questions regarding Medusa’s qualifications as a nurse.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: The Black Blood Resonance Battle! A Small Soul's Grand Struggle Against Fear?
programme.desc: Empowered by black blood, Crona proves difficult to defeat. With their survival on the line, Maka and Soul push themselves to the brink of madness.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: May My Soul Reach You - A Dry Heart Inside Unbearable Isolation?
programme.desc: Maka’s fight with Crona takes a very surprising turn when she puts herself in danger, hoping her actions will free the odd little Meister from a life of pain.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: The Seal Shrine - The Immortal Man's Tricks?
programme.desc: Free and Eruka are perilously close to releasing Asura - close enough to witness a terrifying display of the Kishin’s madness and power.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: Dead or Alive - In the Rift between Revival and Dazzlement?
programme.desc: Dr. Stein and Medusa’s fight reaches a deadly climax, but the battle still rages in Asura’s chamber - if Black☆Star and Kid can’t defeat Eruka and Free, the Kishin will be unsealed.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: The Battle of the Gods - Death City on the Verge of Collapse?
programme.desc: Free from his underground prison, Asura unleashes his terrible powers on Death City! High in the air, above the destruction, Death himself engages the Kishin in battle.

programme.title: Girls' Last Tour
programme.sub-title: Starry Sky / War
programme.desc: Yuuri and Chito make it out of the dark cavern on their Kettenkrad but what will they find on the outside?

programme.title: BOCCHI THE ROCK!
programme.sub-title: Jumping Girl(s)
programme.desc: While Bocchi struggles to write the lyrics to the band's first song, Nijika arranges a special band outing.

programme.title: Aria the Animation
programme.sub-title: With That Transparent Young Girl...
programme.desc: While training in a particularly tough stretch of water, Akari and Aika meet girl from Orange Planet who seems to be having no trouble at all. Her name is Alice, and she's famous for being one of the youngest yet most talented Undines in Neo Venezia. There's just one problem... she never seems to smile. What could she learn from a day spent with the unlikely pair of Akari and Akatsuki?

programme.title: Keep Your Hands Off Eizouken!
programme.sub-title: The Greatest World!
programme.desc: Midori Asakusa is a first year high school student who dreams of creating her own animation. When she visits a screening event held by Anime Club with fellow student Sayaka Kanamori, an amateur model Tsubasa Mizusaki starts talking to them. As she was being chased by men dressed in all black, Asakusa and Kanamori help her get rid of them. To their surprise, they learn that Mizusaki is also aspiring to be an animator. The three of them hit it off to realize their own "Incredible World" together!

programme.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN
programme.sub-title: Hidden Inventory 3
programme.desc: Gojo and Geto beat back the curse users after the bounty placed on Amanai's head when her cell phone rings. A captured Kuroi is displayed on her phone. Gojo tries to bring Amanai back to Jujutsu High, but she insists on going to the negotiations herself.

programme.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
programme.sub-title: Best Friend of the Dead
programme.desc: After finding out that his old rugby buddy from college is in danger, Akira rushes over to Shinjuku to try and save him.

programme.title: Bleach
programme.sub-title: The Immortal Man
programme.desc: After learning to access the power of Zangetsu in addition to his own, Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

programme.title: Soul Eater
programme.sub-title: Medusa's Revival! A Spider and Snake's Fateful Reunion?
programme.desc: Dr. Stein’s trying to whip the Meisters and Weapons into shape for their eventual fight against Arachne. They’ll definitely need to toughen up - Arachne isn’t the only witch who’s back on the scene.

programme.title: Eureka Seven
programme.sub-title: Memory Band
programme.desc: The Gekko has sustained heavy damage after a battle with the military. So they're forced to fly at a low altitude. The mystery surrounding Eureka continues to get stranger than ever as she gradually recovers after returning from the Corallian Zone, and Stoner provides his own explanation for it. Meanwhile, Dominic thinks about all the unanswered questions about Eureka and the Nirvash.

programme.title: IGPX: Immortal Grand Prix
programme.sub-title: Black Egg
programme.desc: Air date: October 19, 2005 "Withdrawal from the IGPX" was the decision of company headquarters. Team manager Satomi Satomi is astounded. The board of directors only gave the team one day. The race has already started, so Satomi leaves for the racetrack, but she can't keep calm inside. Now at the race, the opponent Team Black Egg takes an aggressive defense-only strategy. Takeshi and his teammates encounter difficulty shaking off the tough defense. Can Team Satomi "crack the egg"?

programme.title: The Big O
programme.sub-title: Electric City
programme.desc: Recently, there's been a number of power outages in Paradigm. Roger is hired by Paradigm Power Management to go to the Electric City and negotiate with the locals the reactivation of the hydroelectric power plant. They say a god lives in the water.

programme.title: Samurai Champloo
programme.sub-title: Unholy Union
programme.desc: Fuu harbors a female fugitive who's on the run from a bogus, gun-slinging missionary. The new girl is trouble, no doubt about it, but she may hold the finding the samurai who smells like sunflowers.

programme.title: The Boondocks
programme.sub-title: Pause
programme.desc: Granddad is cast as the leading man by mega-superstar of stage and screen, Winston Jerome. But when the theater group turns out to be a homoerotic evangelical cult, it's up to Huey and Riley to put a pause to it.
